url: local filesystem and record inspection, no network

defect_1_fixture_paths_all_wrong.contents_of_claimed_directory_before_thi: only gate-lilly-verify-*.json, written by a sibling verifier. Zero gate-novo files.
defect_1_fixture_paths_all_wrong.impact: Every one of the 14 declared fixture paths resolves to file-not-found for an orchestrator. The evidence exists but is unreachable at the declared addresses.

defect_2_localhost_labeled_primary_gover.problem: A loopback proxy diagnostic endpoint is labeled a primary government source. Any downstream check of the form 'does this gate rest on at least one primary_government source' passes falsely. It is session telemetry, not evidence about drug pricing.
defect_2_localhost_labeled_primary_gover.remedy: Relabel as session_diagnostic or remove from the sources array entirely.

defect_3_source_type_contradicts_itself_.problem: The same URL carries two different source_type values inside one record. The intent (evidence came only from search snippets, so it cannot confirm) is defensible and conservative on confidence, but the encoding asserts that novocare.com IS a secondary aggregator. A consumer reading data[].source_type would conclude Novo's own patient-facing pharmacy site is an aggregator.
defect_3_source_type_contradicts_itself_.remedy: Keep source_url pointing at the primary URL, set source_type to primary_manufacturer, and carry the not-actually-read status in a separate retrieval_status field. Confidence stays unverified either way.

defect_4_stale_date_placeholders_in_task.observation: The verification task itself arrived with 'Today is undefined' and a fixture directory of 'undefined/'. Fixtures were written to /home/user/GLP-Fund/fixtures/ to match the sibling gate-lilly verifier convention.
defect_4_stale_date_placeholders_in_task.impact: Not a defect in the findings under review; recorded so the orchestrator knows fixture directory resolution was chosen, not specified.
